meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调查 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的 bug，用源码和运行证据判断该由哪个仓库负责，再开出一份英文 GitHub issue（仅 openai/codex 可开 PR），含环境、复现步骤、根因与修复建议。
howto.when: 当你说要报告、提交或归类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 等 bug 时触发；它先抓取最新源码与运行证据，再决定归属仓库。

say.text: 帮我报告一个 LazyCodex 安装器的 bug
say.note: 会定位归属仓库并产出带证据的 issue

say.text: 把这个 Codex 插件 bug 的复现步骤整理成 issue
say.note: 先复现并确认根因再提交

say.text: 先搜一下这个报错有没有已存在的 issue

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude investigates LazyCodex or Codex bugs, uses source and runtime evidence to decide which repo owns the defect, and files an English GitHub issue (or a PR only for openai/codex) with environment, reproduction steps, root cause and fix guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to report, file, open or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin or upstream Codex CLI bug; it first syncs the latest sources and gathers runtime evidence before routing.

say_en.text: Report a bug in the LazyCodex installer
say_en.note: Routes to the owning repo and files an evidence-backed issue.

say_en.text: Turn these Codex plugin bug repro steps into an issue
say_en.note: Reproduces and confirms the root cause first.

say_en.text: Search existing issues for this error first
say_en.note: Comments new evidence if a matching issue exists.
